import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_57/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, select relevant columns, and append to list
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Select only 'movieId' and 'rating' columns as per target schema
        df_selected = df[['movieId', 'rating']]
        dfs.append(df_selected)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Since target examples show one rating per movieId, 
    # aggregate by movieId taking the mean rating
    target_df = combined_df.groupby('movieId', as_index=False)['rating'].mean()

    # Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
    target_df['movieId'] = target_df['movieId'].astype(int)
    target_df['rating'] = target_df['rating'].astype(float)

    # Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_57/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
